The Witcher Is Getting the Full-Cast Audiobook Treatment, Following Rise in Audio Drama Popularity
The Witcher is getting a slate of full-cast audio drama adaptations in 2026 and 2027. Crossroads of Ravens, the prequel novel following an 18-year-old Geralt, is already available and stars Sam Stafford as Young Geralt and Richard Armitage as mentor Preston Holt. The Last Wish and Sword of Destiny will be released in November this year.
